name: DeeSicks
description:
About This Game

Crawl out of your hole, for destiny beckons. Begin as a lowly insect in a primordial soup of bullet-slop misery and rise through the echelons of bullet hell godhood. 

To ascend through the astral planes, you’ll need to out-spam the spammers, out-summon the swarms, and outlast even the toughest of opponents. The solution: become your very own bullet hell boss. Unimaginable power awaits.  

Pick and choose aspects from tailored archetypes such as a dodge-reliant glass cannon, vampiric life-steal and many more. 

On your journey, you will also collect run-changing relics. They may completely redefine your archetype.  
Will you pivot halfway through, or commit to your chosen path to ascension? 

Preparation is power. Before you step into the arena to challenge those who would claim your throne, you are faced with a mysterious board of shifting possibilities. Each character brings their own layout, obstacles, and rules to master. 

Shape your fate through physics-based dice rolls. Trigger volatile multipliers, bending chance in your favor… or pushing you closer to doom. Every roll has the power to redefine what you are becoming. 

What follows is consequence. Slot your dice into spell-bound parameters, forging synergies between your build and the relics you carry. Power is not found, it is assembled. 

Will you commit everything to a single, overwhelming force, or spread your power across a relentless storm of attacks? 

Ascension is not given. It is rolled. 

Unique Progression Model:  

  • Skill-Based Dice Rolling   

  • Classic Spell x Relic Synergies  

  • Pick & Choose from Tailored Archetypes  

  • Various Characters & Game Boards  

  

Simple, Juicy, High-Octane Combat:  

  • Brilliant Mix of Bullet Hell and Bullet Heaven Gameplay  

  • Left-Right Circular Movement  

  • 15 Bosses to Beat (more to come!)  

  • Near-Blinding VFX for Maximum Juice
short_desc: God is dead. Crawl out of your hole and claim your throne. Collect power through physics-based dice rolls, forge devastating builds, and unleash it in escalating bullet hell combat to crush your competition. Destiny has plans for you.
